sources.snippet: About Qwen2.5-7B Qwen2.5-7B is a foundational large language model developed by Alibaba Cloud, forming a part of the Qwen2.5 series. This model is a causal language model engineered for general-purpose applications, serving as a robust base for subsequent fine-tuning and specialized tasks. sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.
